CustomField.label: Margin
CustomField.description: Shipment margin: (Price - Carrier Cost) / Price. Internal, never shown on the site.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: (Price - Carrier Cost) / Price. Internal, never shown on the site.
CustomField.formula: IF( OR( ISBLANK(Price__c), Price__c = 0 ), NULL, (Price__c - BLANKVALUE(Carrier_Cost__c, 0)) / Price__c )
